rule_descriptions.F_HOST_RECEIPT_GATE: Four canonical F-host recovery/output receipts remain mandatory.
rule_descriptions.CONTINUATION_KEY_GATE: Preserve the existing continuation key and task/attempt identity.
rule_descriptions.SINGLE_RUNNER_GATE: Do not create a second task or runner while recovery is unresolved.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Source IDs must remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.OPERATION_SEQUENCE_GATE: Operation IDs must remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.EXAMPLE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Prepared example IDs must remain unique.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_SIM_FRESHNESS: Use current PG10 practice only as title/search discovery evidence.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_TITLEPLAN_VERSION: Track the current title-plan guide version and preserve register-plus-plan context.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_GENERAL_BOUNDARY: Ordinary title-plan boundaries remain general unless determined.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_SEARCH_REGISTER: Register/title-plan retrieval is documentary provenance, not exact geometry.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_SIM_WORKFLOW: Index-map portal success does not prove exact title extent.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_ILLUSTRATIVE_PLAN: Illustrative plans are visual relationship products, not exact extents.
rule_descriptions.OS50_GPKG_ENCODING: GeoPackage contour packaging is not independent numeric evidence.
rule_descriptions.OS50_VECTOR_TILE_CRS: EPSG:3857 vector-tile portrayal must not replace native BNG sampling.
rule_descriptions.OS50_KNOWN_ISSUES: Known-issue status is product QA context, not parcel confidence.
rule_descriptions.OS5_KNOWN_ISSUES: Known-issue status does not promote Terrain 5 to primary source.
rule_descriptions.EA_DTM1M_PRIMARY: Environment Agency DTM1m remains the primary bare-earth terrain source.
rule_descriptions.EA_METADATA_INDEX_REQUIRED: Exact metadata-index feature matching remains required for survey lineage.
rule_descriptions.NO_DATA_NOT_ZERO: Unknown lineage remains unknown, never zero.
rule_descriptions.NUMERIC_PRESERVATION: Existing three parcel measurements are preserved unchanged.
rule_descriptions.RESULT_CONFIDENCE_ROLE: 96% is workflow confidence, not a universal statistical interval.
rule_descriptions.BUSINESS_ROW_GUARD: Business rows remain zero until canonical recovery acceptance.
rule_descriptions.FINAL_READY_GUARD: final_ready remains false while required receipts are absent.
rule_descriptions.WEB_OVERLAY_ROLE: Repository overlay visibility is not live port-8012 acceptance.
rule_descriptions.MAIN_MANIFEST_CONCURRENCY: Do not rewrite the shared main manifest during concurrent slot activity.
